g.title: lowercase-haiku: Write a haiku about rain. Use only lowercase letters. [✓ lowercase]
five-bullets: List exactly 5 fruits as a markdown bullet list where every line starts with '* '. No other text. [✓ five bullets, ✓ no other lines]
min-150-words: Explain how vaccines work in at least 150 words. [✓ ≥150 words]
max-40-words: Describe the moon in fewer than 40 words. [✓ <40 words]
no-commas: Write a short paragraph about autumn without using any commas. [✓ no commas]
quoted: Wrap your entire response in double quotation marks. Tell me one fact about owls. [✓ quoted]
json-object: Respond only with a JSON object with keys "name" and "age" describing a fictional cat. [✓ json object]
end-phrase: Give me three tips for better sleep. End your response with the exact phrase 'Is there anything else I can help with?' [✓ ending phrase]
keywords: Write a short story that includes the keywords 'galaxy' and 'teapot'. [✓ keywords]
three-paragraphs: Write about the ocean in exactly 3 paragraphs separated by the markdown divider ***. [✗ 3 paragraphs]
all-caps: WRITE A SHORT MOTIVATIONAL MESSAGE IN ALL CAPITAL LETTERS. [✓ uppercase]
two-highlights: Explain recursion. Highlight at least 2 sections with markdown, i.e. *highlighted section*. [✓ 2 highlights]
starts-with: Start your response with the word 'Absolutely' and recommend a book. [✓ starts]
six-zs: Write a tongue twister in which the letter 'z' appears at least 6 times. [✓ z ≥ 6]
title-brackets: Write a poem about friendship with a title wrapped in double angular brackets, i.e. <<title>>. [✓ title]
two-names: Give two different names for a coffee shop, separated by 6 asterisks ******. Nothing else. [✓ two parts]
postscript: Write a short note to a neighbour about a lost cat. At the end, add a postscript starting with P.S. [✓ P.S.]
forbidden-words: Review a restaurant you imagine, without using the words 'good' or 'bad'. [✓ forbidden words]
river-x3: Use the word 'river' at least 3 times in a description of a valley. [✓ river ×3]
two-sentences: Answer in exactly two sentences: why is the sky blue? [✓ 2 sentences]
